notes.title: Release date confirmed
notes.content: We'll be releasing the game on May 30.

notes.title: Cognizer to release on Steam "soon™".
notes.content:
In March 2016, Maniac Games released Cognizer for iOS and Android. It is a very challenging atmospheric puzzle game. Since the game works just as well with a touch screen or mouse input, bringing it to OSX/Linux/Windows made a lot of sense. We're just cleaning up some final details before releasing it to the public.

As with the iOS and Android versions, the game will be a free download on Steam. There are no locked features, and the only DLC available is strictly for donating to the developer to support the next game.
